trades.name: MMS
trades.why: Three sessions after a guide below last year's earnings, free cash flow of $69M against a $425-475M guide and a federal backlog down 30%, Maximus broke its 20-day low on 1.7x volume on a day value and defensive stocks rose; only two analysts cover it, so the reset is still being absorbed.
trades.wrong_if: Maximus announces a material new or extended federal contract, or the VA reinstates the exam incentives; or Maximus raises its fiscal 2027 EPS or free-cash-flow guide or files that it has collected the federal receivables behind the cash-flow miss; or it discloses buybacks running well ahead of its $200M plan or insider buying; or both covering analysts upgrade it, inside the window.
trades.deferred_from: queued for 8:35 AM CT: spread wider than 0.5% (KIE 21.8%, MMS 30.7%)

trades.name: TPL
trades.why: Texas Pacific Land closed at a 52-week low on 2.1x volume on a day crude rose 2.3% and XOP rose: the premium it carried for data-center deals is being taken back, with no deal a quarter after management called them very near and Texas pausing data-center grid connections and permits.
trades.wrong_if: Texas Pacific Land announces a definitive data-center, power or desalination agreement; or the governor, ERCOT, the PUC or the TCEQ lifts or narrows the data-center interconnection audit or permit pause; or the company discloses share buybacks or a special dividend; or two or more covering brokers upgrade it, inside the window.
trades.deferred_from: queued for 8:35 AM CT: spread wider than 0.5% (TPL 11.4%)

trades.name: DE
trades.why: Deere missed and guided fiscal 2027 profit well under the Street, opened -4.2% and was bought to +4.7% on 3.7x volume: the market read the first guide for growth in North American large farm equipment as the bottom of the cycle, and the bad numbers as already paid for.
trades.wrong_if: Two or more covering brokers downgrade Deere after the print; or China, the EU or another major buyer announces retaliatory tariffs or a purchase halt on US farm goods in answer to the 11-25 tariff proposal; or Deere, CNH or AGCO says North American large-ag orders or early-order programs have weakened since the report, inside the window.

trades.name: J
trades.why: A print that beat is being sold harder on day two than day one, -5.3% against XLI +0.7% with no headline: holders are leaving on a guide that is in line at best and a quarter flattered by a 53rd week, and nothing is dated before February to stop it.
trades.wrong_if: Two or more covering brokers upgrade Jacobs after the print; or Jacobs announces an accelerated or enlarged buyback, or a contract award it calls material, in a filing or release; or a major outlet reports a one-off cause for the two-day drop (a block sale, an index change), inside the window.

trades.name: WMB
trades.why: A new director who built a power and energy private-equity firm made his first open-market buy, $978,650 at about $65, at a company where insiders almost never buy, with the stock 10% off on leverage and yields while the business is at records.
trades.wrong_if: Williams prices new equity or equity-linked financing, or announces a power project on terms the press or brokers call dilutive; or two or more covering brokers downgrade it; or Turner or another insider files a sale; or the 10-year Treasury yield closes above 5.0%, inside the window.
